utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look today. Keep it simple and I’ll bring the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. That would help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great. I’ll stop by later and bring what I need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just want to be sure we’ve got the timing and materials lined up before anyone starts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the timing and materials one more time? I want to make sure nothing’s been missed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — timing is set for Saturday morning, and we’ve got the replacement parts and sealant on hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed the update, what changed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think we changed a few repair spots and posted the updated list, but I might be mixing up the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I probably missed that update too. Can you point me to the updated list so I can catch up?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. Let me know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll keep an eye out and let you know what turns up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, keep me posted and I’ll be ready to help when something turns up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Gus. How’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Pretty good so far — we’ve got a steady line of folks coming through, and I’ve still got a few tools to lend out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to hear it. I can take a look at the tools if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can do that tomorrow morning, if Quinn still wants me on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Eli — count me in for tomorrow morning on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, see you tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive, Sam?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Mostly the loose wiring and a couple of cracked hinges in the common shed need attention. I’ll point them out when we get there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. I’ll look for the wiring and hinges when we’re there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive is coming together, and I can help connect whoever still needs tools or a hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules. I’m keeping track of who still needs what, so send them my way and I’ll note it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, send me anyone who’s still missing tools or a pair of hands, and I’ll point them your way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing, and I’ll pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thank you. I still need someone to coordinate the paint, and I can use help sorting the materials and handing out the sign-up list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take paint coordination and the materials sorting, and I’ll help hand out the sign-up list too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a spare tarp and some tape I can bring by. Tell Bo I’m keeping an eye on the supply box, too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo. That helps a lot, and I’ll keep track of the box on my end too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Glad to hear it. I’ll keep the box stocked and bring the tarp and tape by for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is moving along pretty well. Folks have been dropping things off all afternoon, so there’s still time to help out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I might stop by later and see if they need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What exactly needs repairing, and when is the drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s mostly loose wiring and a couple of broken outlets, and the drive is this Saturday morning at the school.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. I can check on the Saturday morning drive at the school and focus on the loose wiring and broken outlets.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll let you know what time I can drop by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, just let me know the time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Vik. I’ll let the others know you’re in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I must've missed the change, can you remind me what's happening?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it’s just the repair drive this week. I can send you the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, send me the details and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive. I can help if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey. I could use the extra hands, and maybe a drill if you’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, I appreciate it. I can bring my drill by later and help get things moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the signup sheet ready, Opal. If you can spare an hour this week, I’ll put you down and match you with an easy repair task.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure, put me down for an hour this week, and I’m happy to take an easy repair task.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll mark you down for this week and find you an easy job on the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know when the repair drive is and what I should bring so I can plan the trip.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: The repair drive is this Saturday morning at the community hall, and just bring work gloves if you have them. I’ll send the exact time and any extra supplies soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me - I’ll wait for your exact time and the extra supplies so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is actually happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not completely sure yet, so I’d want to confirm the time and who’s bringing what before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, I’m not saying yes until we know the time and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear schedule for it, Dane. Tell me when the drive starts and what needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: The drive starts Saturday morning, and first thing we’re sorting the tools and the broken fixtures.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. I’d like the tools sorted first, then we can move to the broken fixtures.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive's moving along, but I'm only getting it second-hand. What's the latest from your side?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s moving; we’ve got most of the supplies in and the first fixes started. I’m keeping track of what’s still short.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to hear; what’s still short, and do you need another pair of hands?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I may have missed the latest details, but I’m here to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s kind of you. I’ll send you the latest details and we can figure out where you’d help most.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara. Send them when you can, and I’ll jump in wherever you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup, but I need to keep my morning tight.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works. I’ll handle the rest this morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks. I’ll take the afternoon stuff and keep you posted.
